Indian women team wins FIH Hockey Nations Cup to mark Pro League return
Intro: India were crowned champions of the FIH Hockey Women’s Nations Cup New Zealand 2025-26 on June 21 after defeating the hosts 2-0 in the final at Auckland on Sunday. Navneet Kaur (4’) gave India the early lead before Sunelita Toppo (15’) doubled India's advantage. The team produced a stellar defensive display to protect its lead and win the title, which also marked India’s return to the women’s FIH Pro League next season.
